title: Devin Manages Devins - Parallel Cloud Agents
description: Devin can now orchestrate multiple Devins and manage setups directly from any session, replacing Advanced Devin with parallel cloud agents. Features include session management with structured output schemas, knowledge management with folders, playbook management, and schedule management for recurring sessions.

title: Persistent Agent Thread Release
description: Claude released a persistent agent thread feature for Pro and Max plans, allowing users to manage tasks in Cowork mode from both mobile and desktop devices with improved continuity across work sessions.

community_feedback.quote: Devs hate it - Anthropic updated Claude Code to hide file names during progress output, which developers criticized for reducing transparency
The vibe changed after Claude Code + Claude 4.0 release, with many engineers believing coding/engineering is solved
After the outage on March 17th, 2026, users reported Claude Code seemed to get 'dumber' with performance degradation

title: v0.34.0 - Faster Startup & Loop Detection
description: Latest stable release with significantly faster startup times, improved loop detection and recovery mechanisms to prevent getting stuck, new /footer command for session customization, chat resume footer functionality, and general UI polish.

title: v0.33.0 - Agent-to-Agent Authentication
description: Added HTTP authentication for A2A (Agent-to-Agent) remote agents, authenticated A2A agent card functionality for improved security, and core bug fixes including EISDIR error handling.

title: JetBrains Plugin v2.12.14
description: Version 2.12.14 released for JetBrains IDEs (compatible with 2024.3+) as part of continued active development with fixes and improvements.

title: v0.32.0 - Generalist Agent & Model Steering
description: Generalist agent enabled to improve task delegation and routing, plus new model steering capabilities in workspace for better control over agent behavior.

title: Platform Improvements - PWA Support
description: Minor bug fixes, performance improvements, visual polish, and new Progressive Web App installation on desktop and mobile. Browser tab favicon now shows colored status dot (green when working, orange when waiting).

community_feedback.quote: Where did Devin go? The conversation has faded out over the past year, with users discussing what this says about the future of AI dev tools

title: March 2026 Updates - GPT-5.4 Support
description: Codex CLI 0.111.0 released on March 5, 2026 with support for GPT-5.4. Users need to update CLI, IDE extension, or Codex app to access the latest model.

community_feedback.quote: Codex is the recommended choice for most Codex tasks, noting it's the first general-purpose model in Codex with native computer-use capabilities
New Codex review: It just works - after 3+ months of usage experience

title: March 2026 Usage Promotions
description: Claude introduced new usage promotions including a $50-per-week plan targeted at solo game developers and open-source developers, with bonus usage during off-peak hours not counting toward weekly limits.

community_feedback.quote: $50-per-week Codex Pro/Claude Max plan would be perfect for solo gamedevs/open-source devs
Claude Code Opus is God-Tier web development
